instruction: Studio photograph, medium shot at eye-level. In an indoor setting with white vertical wood-paneled walls, a woman in a denim shirt (R2) stands behind a man in a dark blue t-shirt (R1). The man (R1) is bent forward at the waist, clutching his throat with gloved hands and looking down in distress. The woman (R2), wearing white medical gloves, stands behind the man, looking down at him with a focused expression as she prepares to administer aid. Bright, even indoor lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows.
